start.help: Let Auto Astro set everything in one click, or start from a preset. You can fine-tune each step afterwards.

stack.help: Bring the faint detail out of your stacked image.
stack.more: The linear stacked composite, before any creative work: stretch the faint signal, subtract the sky gradient, neutralise the colour. Non-destructive - it all recomputes from the 32-bit data.

frame.help: Set the frame first - crop, level the horizon, rotate or flip. Everything after this works on the framed image.
frame.unavailable: Framing needs the original image dimensions, which aren't available for a stacked composite.

sky.help: Remove light pollution and colour casts so the sky looks natural.
sky.more: Clean up the raw signal before any creative grading: white balance, lens vignetting, light-pollution gradients, and haze.

light.help: How bright and punchy the image is.
light.more: Overall exposure and tonal balance - how bright, contrasty, and full of shadow and highlight detail the image reads.

curves.help: Fine control over light and dark tones - optional.
curves.more: Fine-tune tone and colour with a master curve, then per-channel red/green/blue curves for grading.

colour.help: Make the colours more or less vivid.
colour.more: How vivid the colours are. Vibrance protects already-saturated areas; saturation scales everything.

detail.help: Smooth away grain and bring out fine structure.
detail.more: Local texture: micro-contrast, noise reduction, and sharpening. Do this after tone and colour are settled.

stars.help: Make stars smaller, or remove them to work on the nebula alone.
stars.more: Two ways to handle stars: shrink them where they are, or lift them out entirely so the rest of your edit only touches the nebula.

depth.help: Turn your image into a gentle animated 3D effect.
depth.more: Pick the focal point, then open the Depth Shift viewer for an interactive parallax preview.

style.help: Optional: give your image a finishing style for sharing. Tap a style, then set its strength.
style.more: Each style only reworks the light your camera recorded - contrast, colour, a soft glow from the bright parts. Nothing is invented: no added stars, no fake detail. You can still download the image without its style in the Export step.

export.help: Save your image, or keep these settings for your next photos.

tone_curve.title: Tone curve
tone_curve.help: Drag a point to reshape the curve, double-click empty space to add one, double-click a point to remove it.

contrast.label: Contrast
contrast.hint: Stretches the tonal range around the image's midpoint, separating faint detail from bright.

exposure.label: Exposure
exposure.hint: Shifts overall luminance up or down.

highlights.label: Highlights
highlights.hint: Recovers or boosts bright detail - weighted toward the brightest pixels only.

shadows.label: Shadows
shadows.hint: Lifts or deepens dark detail - weighted toward the darkest pixels only.

whites.label: Whites
whites.hint: Pushes the white clipping point - narrower and more aggressive than Highlights, only the near-white tail.

blacks.label: Blacks
blacks.hint: Pushes the black clipping point - narrower and more aggressive than Shadows, only the near-black tail.

vignetteCorrection.label: Vignette
vignetteCorrection.hint: Positive brightens the corners (counteracts lens vignetting); negative darkens them (deepen a vignette, or tame an over-corrected stack).

gradientReduction.label: Light-pollution gradient
gradientReduction.hint: Flattens smooth background gradients - light pollution, sky glow.

dehaze.label: Remove haze
dehaze.hint: Restores contrast and colour lost to a veiling haze or light-pollution glow.

clarity.label: Clarity
clarity.hint: Local contrast via unsharp masking. Negative values soften instead.

denoise.label: Denoise
denoise.hint: Multiscale (wavelet) noise reduction on brightness. Removes grain while keeping stars and fine filaments; higher smooths deeper.

chromaDenoise.label: Colour noise reduction
chromaDenoise.hint: Multiscale smoothing of colour speckle only, leaving brightness detail untouched.

starReduction.label: Star reduction
starReduction.hint: Shrinks and dims star points so faint nebulosity stands out more.

starSensitivity.label: Catch fainter stars
starSensitivity.hint: How faint a point can be and still count as a star. Higher finds more, fainter stars.

starMaxSize.label: Largest star size
starMaxSize.hint: Caps how large a bright spot can be and still count as a star, so bright cores aren't shrunk.

starRemoval.label: Remove stars
starRemoval.hint: Pulls the stars out so every other adjustment works on the nebula alone.

starRecombine.label: Bring stars back
starRecombine.hint: Screen-blends the removed stars back at the end: 0 keeps the image starless, 100 restores them full strength.

sharpness.label: Sharpness
sharpness.hint: Below 1 softens. Above 1 sharpens stars and fine structure only where they rise above the noise, so the background grain is not sharpened.

vibrance.label: Vibrance
vibrance.hint: Boosts saturation, weighted toward already-muted colours so vivid areas stay natural.

saturation.label: Saturation
saturation.hint: Scales colour intensity uniformly across the whole image.

temperature.label: Temperature
temperature.hint: White balance: lower K warms the image (amber), higher K cools it (blue). 6500 K is neutral. Snaps to standard values.

tint.label: Tint
tint.hint: White balance: shifts the colour cast between green and magenta.

greenRemoval.label: Remove green cast
greenRemoval.hint: Removes a residual green cast (SCNR). Almost nothing in the deep sky is green; a teal OIII filament keeps its colour because blue backs it up.

stretch.label: Stretch
stretch.hint: How hard to lift the faint signal out of the background. Low keeps the sky dark and subtle; high pulls up dim nebulosity at the cost of a brighter, noisier background.

stretch_mode.adaptive_hint: Colour-preserving stretch fitted to this image: bright cores keep their structure and stars keep their colour instead of burning to white.
stretch_mode.classic_hint: The original per-channel auto-stretch, for comparison. Brighter, but clips galaxy cores and whitens stars.

background_extraction.label: Background extraction
background_extraction.hint: Removes a smooth light-pollution / sky-glow gradient by fitting a low-order surface to the sky between the objects. 0 leaves the gradient in; 100 subtracts all of it.

color_calibration.label: Colour calibration
color_calibration.hint: Neutralises the sky background to grey and white-balances on the star field: the median of the unsaturated stars is made white. Because the reference is the stars, not the whole frame, a red emission nebula or the blue Pleiades keep their real colour.

reduce.heading: Reduce stars
reduce.help: Shrinks every star where it is - quick, and every star is kept.

remove.heading: Remove stars
remove.help: Lifts the stars out so the other steps only touch the nebula; the second slider fades them back in at the end.

engine.hint: Uses the StarNet2 model installed on the server. The first pass on a new image can take a while; detection controls below don't apply.

detection.heading: Which points are stars
detection.help: Both tools above use this. Turn on the star mask to check what is picked up.

engine.hint: Uses the DeepSNR model installed on the server, applied early (before the tone stretch). The first pass on a new image can take a while.

max_upload.label: Maximum upload size
max_upload.hint: Uploads larger than this are rejected. Megabytes.

session_ttl.label: Session lifetime
session_ttl.hint: How long a session and its working files are kept. Hours.

preview_size.label: Preview size
preview_size.hint: Longest edge of the fast-display preview image. Pixels.

stacking_max.label: Maximum frames
stacking_max.hint: Upper bound on frames accepted for one stack.

stacking_retention.label: Stack retention
stacking_retention.hint: How long a stack's uploaded frames are kept for re-stacking. The composite keeps the session lifetime. Hours.

stacking_workers.label: Stacking threads
stacking_workers.hint: Parallel threads for the align/combine passes. 0 = auto (CPU count, capped at 4); 1 = sequential. Raise on a many-core machine.

stacking_watch_dir.label: Watch folder
stacking_watch_dir.hint: A server path the worker polls for new frames (empty = off). New images are ingested into a rolling stack you can open from the stacking screen.

stacking_watch_idle.label: Watch auto-stack after
stacking_watch_idle.hint: Process the watch stack once no new frame has arrived for this many minutes.

stacking_watch_auto.label: Auto-stack the watch folder
stacking_watch_auto.hint: When off, watched frames are only ingested - start the stack yourself from the stacking screen.

allowlist.label: Astrodex origin allowlist
allowlist.hint: One URL prefix per line - the MyAstroBoard origin(s) a handoff may come from, e.g. https://astro.example.com. Empty means every Astrodex handoff is refused.

max_retries.label: Maximum retries
max_retries.hint: Delivery attempts before the return to Astrodex is marked failed.

cors_origins.label: CORS origins
cors_origins.hint: One origin per line. Takes effect after the api service restarts.

rate_limit_enabled.label: Rate limiting
rate_limit_enabled.hint: Caps how often one IP can upload, process, or stack images.

rate_limit_per_minute.label: Requests per minute
rate_limit_per_minute.hint: Per IP, shared across upload/process/stack endpoints.

max_concurrent_jobs.label: Concurrent jobs
max_concurrent_jobs.hint: Maximum enhance/stack jobs running at once, per IP.

log_file_level.label: File log level
log_file_level.hint: Level written to the rotating log file.

log_console_level.label: Console log level
log_console_level.hint: Level echoed to the container logs.

advanced.external_engines_blurb: Nothing is bundled: download the Linux x64 CLI package from starnetastro.com and install it below, or point a path at a binary you mounted yourself. You are responsible for the tool's own licence terms. Leave empty to keep the classical engines.

starnet2_path.label: StarNet2 binary path
starnet2_path.hint: Absolute path inside the container, e.g. /opt/engines/starnet2/starnet2.

starnet2_stride.label: StarNet2 stride
starnet2_stride.hint: Tile stride, even, 2-512. 0 = use StarNet2's own default (256). Larger is faster and coarser; smaller is slower with fewer seams.

deepsnr_path.label: DeepSNR binary path
deepsnr_path.hint: Absolute path inside the container. Adds a DeepSNR option to the Detail step's denoise control, applied early in the pipeline.

deepsnr_stride.label: DeepSNR stride
deepsnr_stride.hint: Tile stride, even, 2-512. 0 = use DeepSNR's own default (480).

backup.blurb: Download your settings and custom presets as one file, or restore them from a previous export - not sessions or images, which are meant to expire.

retention.label: Job history retention
retention.hint: How long a finished job is kept before the hourly cleanup removes it. Hours.
